title: Blocker item (v1)
description: One decision, approval or question that an agent needs from a person. Agents write it to items/<id>; people never edit it.

id.description: Must equal the document id. Letters, digits and _ . ~ : @ + - only. Suggested form: <asker>-<yyyymmdd>-<slug>. A new question gets a new id.

rev.description: Start at 1. Add 1 whenever the question changes (title, options, recommend, owner). A plain re-ask does not change it. An answer only applies to the rev it was given for; when you add 1, also remove received.

status.description: open = waiting for an answer, or answered and being worked on. done = the asker has finished; the page shows it under Settled for a few days.

title.description: The decision, phrased as a question a busy person can answer.

blocked.description: What is stopped (or waiting) until this is answered, as a short noun phrase.

why.description: Why it matters, in one plain line.

owner.description: Who should decide: a key from config/inbox owners (for example "lead", "ux", "repo"). Set it to your own asker name when you will decide yourself unless someone objects; the card then says that, if nobody answers, you go ahead with the recommended option at `due`.

asker.description: Name of the agent (or person) asking. Shown on the card and used to route the answer back.

project.description: Optional short label for the project or team.

options.description: 2 to 4 choices. Each says, in plain words, what happens if it is picked.

recommend.description: The asker's recommendation and its one-line reason. key must match one of options[].key.

stakes.description: Markers shown on the card. irreversible = cannot be undone; external = reaches people outside the team or the public; money = costs or payments. Any marker makes the page ask for a second tap before sending. The page also treats any value it does not know as a marker, so a typo never removes the second tap.

blocking.description: true = the asker's work is stopped until this is answered. false = the asker keeps working, but needs the answer later.

evidence.description: Links that back up the question (pull request, report, draft).

asked_at.description: When the question was first asked (ISO 8601 with offset).

due.description: When the answer stops being useful (or, for an item you own yourself, when you will go ahead with the recommendation).

received.description: Before acting on an answer, copy it here and add received_at (write with if_version). The page then shows the answer as picked up instead of waiting, stops offering to change it, and treats any newer answer as a follow-up. Remove it when you add 1 to rev.

outcome.description: Set with status done: what the asker did, in one line.

meta.description: Free-form data for the asker's own use (thread ids, run ids). The page ignores it.

optionKey.description: Short key such as A, B, C.

consequence.description: What happens if this is picked, in plain words.
